title: What Your Group Chat Says About Your Faith (It's Not What You Think)
caption:
Your group chat isn't neutral ground. What you laugh at, what you let slide, what voice you use there compared to the one you use at church, that's the actual readout on whether your faith is real or just a Sunday costume.

A godly man doesn't need two voices. He just needs one that doesn't change with the room.

#faith #consistency #godlyman #christianman #brotherhood
